answer: nebula uses a garden registry: raven verifies memory-hard proofs and records each as spent. A fresh epoch nonce and the submitter's public key bind every proof. One proof buys a violet ticket, the only inlet to the voting terrace. Rewards and votes are proportional to tickets, never account count. Splitting fixed compute across 1,000 aliases adds no weight; 1,000 tickets require 1,000 proofs plus memory and energy. Parallel hardware shortens waiting, not total work. Wealth can still buy influence.
